Token Generation

BoobaStudio's Token Generation feature creates AI-generated portraits and token images for your actors and NPCs. Generate character art that matches your game system's visual style and apply it directly to actor sheets and tokens.

Overview

Token Generation creates portrait and token artwork for actors using AI image generation. It uses the actor's description, name, and game system context to produce fitting character art.

How It Works

  • Select an Actor — open an actor sheet or select a token on the canvas
  • Open the Generator — use the BoobaStudio icon on the actor sheet
  • Review the Prompt — BoobaStudio auto-generates a prompt from the actor's description
  • Choose a Model — pick an image generation model
  • Generate — the AI creates character artwork
  • Apply — set the result as the actor's portrait and/or token image

Accessing Token Generation

From the Actor Sheet

  • Open any actor sheet
  • Click the BoobaStudio icon in the sheet header
  • Select Generate Image to create a portrait

From the Sidebar Context Menu

  • In the Actors sidebar tab, right-click on an actor
  • Select the BoobaStudio AI option from the context menu

From the BoobaStudio menu

  • Open the BoobaStudio radial menu
  • Choose to generate for an existing actor or create a new one

From the Token HUD

  • Select a token on the canvas
  • Open the Token HUD
  • Click the BoobaStudio icon for generation options

Auto-Prompt Generation

BoobaStudio reads the actor's data to create a fitting prompt:

  • Name — the character's name influences the style
  • Description/Biography — physical appearance details are extracted
  • Type — NPC, character, creature, vehicle, etc. adjusts the prompt
  • Game System — fantasy, sci-fi, modern, etc. determines the art style

Portrait vs Token

The generator can produce:

  • Portrait — larger, detailed character artwork for the actor sheet
  • Token — circular or square image optimized for the canvas token

Tips

  • Fill in the actor's description first — the more detail, the better the AI prompt
  • Use image-to-image for consistent styles — generate a base image, then use it as reference for variants
  • Try "Both" mode — generates portrait and token art in one step
  • Batch generate — right-click a folder of actors to generate images for multiple characters

Requirements

  • BoobaStudio module installed and configured
  • At least one actor in your world
  • A configured provider (Module Settings → BoobaStudio)
  • Credit with your configured provider
